title: Catat tab shows today's total mic button and recent list shell
steps: 1. Open Catat tab
expected_result: Shows "Pengeluaran Hari Ini" total, large microphone button, "Ketuk untuk Bicara" text, "Input Manual" button, "Baru Saja" list

title: Today's total equals sum of today's transactions Rp 0 when none
preconditions: At least one transaction saved today
steps:
1. Note today's transactions and their harga values
2. Compare to displayed total
3. Delete all today's transactions and reload
expected_result: Total = sum of harga for all of the user's transactions since 00:00 today; shows "Rp 0" with none

title: Recent list shows at most 3 of today's transactions newest first
steps:
1. Save 4+ transactions today
2. View "Baru Saja" list
expected_result: At most 3 rows shown, newest on top; each row shows category icon, platform (or category name if platform empty), "Kategori . Metode", amount prefixed with "-"

title: Empty state when no transactions today
steps: 1. Open Catat tab with no transactions today
expected_result: "Belum ada transaksi hari ini." shown; no "Lihat Semua" link

title: Lihat Semua navigates to Riwayat
steps: 1. Click "Lihat Semua"
expected_result: Navigates to Riwayat tab

title: Total and recent list update live without reload
steps:
1. Add a new transaction (e.g. via another tab/device or Input Manual)
2. Delete a transaction
expected_result: Total and "Baru Saja" list update automatically without a page reload

title: Realtime sync across two open sessions
preconditions: Same account signed in on two tabs/devices
steps:
1. Add/delete a transaction on device A
2. Observe device B
expected_result: Change made on A appears on B without manual refresh

title: Tapping mic starts recording with listening feedback
steps: 1. Tap the microphone button
expected_result: Recording starts: "Mendengarkan..." text, button becomes a stop button, beep sound starts (+ vibration if supported)

title: Tapping stop while recording begins processing
steps: 1. Tap the stop button
expected_result: Recording stops, beep stops, "Memproses..." shown, button disabled during processing

title: 2 seconds of silence auto-stops recording
steps: 1. Stay silent for at least 2 seconds while recording
expected_result: Recording auto-stops, then processes the same as tapping stop (VOICE-02)

title: Recording auto-stops at 60 seconds
preconditions: Recording continuously with no silence gap
steps: 1. Keep speaking/recording continuously
expected_result: Recording auto-stops exactly at 60 seconds

title: Accidental recording under 0.8s is discarded silently
steps: 1. Tap mic and release/stop in under 0.8 seconds
expected_result: Ignored: no request sent, no transaction created, no error shown; UI returns to normal

title: Denied mic permission shows an alert
preconditions: Mic permission denied at OS/browser level
steps: 1. Tap the microphone button
expected_result: Alert "Membutuhkan akses mikrofon."; UI returns to ready state

title: Voice input blocked while offline
steps: 1. Tap the microphone button while offline
expected_result: Alert that voice recording needs internet and suggests "Input Manual"; recording does not start

title: High/medium confidence voice result is saved with success toast
preconditions: Online, mic permission granted; voice input yields high or medium confidence
steps: 1. Record a clear expense sentence
expected_result: Transaction saved; success toast shown (see SAVE-01)

title: Low confidence voice result is not saved shows low-confidence modal and is logged
preconditions: Voice input yields low confidence (e.g. unclear/noisy audio)
steps: 1. Record unclear/ambiguous audio
expected_result: Transaction not saved; "Suara Kurang Jelas" modal shown; a low-confidence log is recorded with source = voice

title: Server/AI failure during voice processing shows an alert and saves nothing
preconditions: Voice request will fail server-side (e.g. AI service error)
steps: 1. Record a voice input while the AI service is failing
expected_result: Alert "Gagal memproses suara. ..."; no transaction saved; mic button becomes active again

title: Starting a new recording dismisses an existing success toast
preconditions: A success toast is currently shown
steps: 1. While the toast is visible tap the mic and start recording again
expected_result: The old toast is dismissed

title: Save success toast shows summary and action buttons
steps: 1. Save a transaction via voice or manual input
expected_result: Toast shows "Tersimpan: {platform or category}", a "Kategori . Rp ..." line, a detail line, and "Edit Transaksi" & "Batal" buttons

title: Toast auto-dismisses after about 5 seconds
steps: 1. Leave the toast untouched
expected_result: Toast disappears automatically after roughly 5 seconds

title: Dismissing toast with the close icon keeps the transaction
steps: 1. Click the close (x) icon on the toast
expected_result: Toast disappears; transaction remains saved

title: Undo (Batal) removes the transaction and reduces today's total
steps: 1. Click "Batal" on the toast
expected_result: Toast disappears; transaction is deleted; today's total decreases accordingly

title: Edit Transaksi from toast opens the edit modal pre-filled
steps: 1. Click "Edit Transaksi"
expected_result: Toast disappears; edit modal opens pre-filled with that transaction's data

title: Edit modal Platform field is required max 50 chars with counter
steps:
1. Clear the Platform field and try to save
2. Type more than 50 characters into Platform
expected_result: Platform required to save; input capped at 50 chars with an "n/50" counter

title: Category/Payment method are type-ahead selects and unmatched text reverts
steps:
1. Type a partial match, e.g. "pay", into the payment method field, then press Enter/click outside
2. Type text that matches nothing, then click outside
expected_result: Partial match resolves to the matching fixed option (e.g. Paylater); text matching nothing reverts to the previous value

title: Price field enforces digit-only cap and non-negative
steps:
1. Enter a value with 10+ digits or greater than 999999999
2. Try to enter a negative value
expected_result: Value is capped at 999.999.999; negative values are not accepted

title: Notes field is optional max 200 chars with counter
steps:
1. Leave Catatan empty and save
2. Type more than 200 characters into Catatan
expected_result: Empty Catatan is accepted; input capped at 200 chars with an "n/200" counter

title: Saving edits updates Home Riwayat and Bulanan
preconditions: Edit modal open with changes made
steps:
1. Change one or more fields
2. Click "Simpan Perubahan"
expected_result: Modal closes; the change is reflected on Home, Riwayat, and Bulanan

title: Closing edit modal without saving discards changes
preconditions: Edit modal open with unsaved changes
steps:
1. Change a field
2. Click the close (x) icon to close the modal
expected_result: Changes are discarded; transaction unchanged

title: Low-confidence modal shows title explanation and two actions
preconditions: A voice/text input resulted in low confidence
steps: 1. Trigger a low-confidence result
expected_result: Modal titled "Suara Kurang Jelas" with explanation, "Input Manual" and "Tutup" buttons

title: Tutup dismisses the low-confidence modal without creating a transaction
steps: 1. Click "Tutup"
expected_result: Modal closes; no new transaction created

title: Input Manual from low-confidence modal opens the manual input modal
steps: 1. Click "Input Manual"
expected_result: Low-confidence modal closes; Input Manual modal opens

title: Low-confidence event is logged with transcript rejected output and source
preconditions: A low-confidence result occurred (voice or text)
steps:
1. Trigger a low-confidence result from voice
2. Trigger a low-confidence result from text
expected_result: One log document per event containing raw transcript, the rejected AI output, source (voice/text), and input_text present only when source = text
